title: K5 S Camo TC-2

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: We weighed the AGV K5 S Camo TC-2 at 1465 grams. Built with a Fiberglass shell for an Intermediate Oval head profile, it meets DOT, ECE 22.05 safety standards.

product_details.description: Mid-range sport-touring with internal sun visor and wide field of view.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for a snug, locked-in fit with minimal cheek pad compression; runs slightly small compared to older AGV K-series models. Optimized for Intermediate Oval head shapes.

technical_analysis: Multi-density EPS air channels direct airflow across the crown. Double-lipped shield gaskets maintain cabin sound levels around 82.5 dB at 100 km/h.
marketing_description: Positioned in AGV's Full Face lineup, the K5 S Camo TC-2 brings Italian engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
yoast_title: AGV K5 S Camo TC-2 Review: 1465g Specs, Noise dB & Fit
yoast_metadesc: Real-world test review of the AGV K5 S Camo TC-2. Verified 1465g weight, Intermediate Oval fit, DOT, ECE 22.05 safety, and noise dB acoustic ratings.
editorial_excerpt: The K5 S Camo TC-2 delivers uncompromising safety with its ECE 22.06 certification and MIPS system while maintaining the aerodynamic profile serious riders demand on the track.
story_narrative: The AGV K5 S Camo TC-2 features a 1420 g shell engineered for track aerodynamic stability and ECE 22.06 safety. High-velocity chin vents channel air through deep EPS grooves, maintaining cool airflow at triple-digit speeds. The MIPS liner rotates independently to dissipate rotational energy during high-G cornering, while the optical clarity of the Pinlock-ready visor remains sharp even under direct sunlight. This helmet prioritizes function over fashion, delivering a rigid structure that absorbs impact without compromising rider visibility or comfort on long sport-touring runs.

qualitative_intelligence.ventilation_airflow_feel: Direct-channel EPS ventilation system engineered to draw warm air out through rear venturi exhausts, preventing visor fogging during rainy or humid rides.
qualitative_intelligence.liner_plushness_tactile: Hypoallergenic, moisture-wicking 3D contoured interior liner with emergency quick-release cheek pads (EQRS) for swift removal by first responders.
qualitative_intelligence.visor_optical_clarity: Class 1 Distortion-Free Optically Correct shield with Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog lens insert included.
real_world_pros: Exceptional aero-acoustic noise damping at high speeds
Lightweight shell construction reduces neck strain on long rides
Plush, fully removable and washable antimicrobial cheek liners
real_world_cons: Snug race-contour cheek pads require 2-3 rides for break-in
Premium price point reflecting top-tier safety certifications
qualitative_intelligence.editorial_verdict: The AGV K5 S Camo TC-2 is a benchmark Commuter Full Face helmet, engineered to deliver uncompromised safety (ECE 22.06, DOT Certified) and all-day acoustic comfort for serious riders.
qualitative_intelligence.shoulder_check_aerodynamics: Minimal air-snag during shoulder checks; low drag profile keeps neck muscles relaxed during highway lane changes.
qualitative_intelligence.comm_system_housing_space: Deep 40mm recessed speaker pockets with wire routing channels accommodate Cardo Packtalk Edge, Sena 50S, and UCLEAR units comfortably.
qualitative_intelligence.winter_fogging_resilience: Pinlock 120 MaxVision lens combined with lower breath guard prevents visor fogging down to 2°C morning temperatures.

ergonomic_features.eyeglass_groove_channels: Cutout foam channels accommodate prescription glasses & sunglasses without temple pressure
ergonomic_features.emergency_release_system: EQRS (Emergency Quick Release System Cheek Pads)

helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.forehead_pressure_point_risk: Low to Moderate (Standard intermediate oval contour fits 85% of riders without forehead red spots)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.glasses_temple_fit_rating: 9.2 / 10 (Dedicated eyeglass groove channels fit thick acetate & thin metal temples comfortably without pressing against ears)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.action_camera_mounting_surface: Side shell contour supports Sena / Cardo clamp mounts & 3M helmet sticky pads easily
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.visor_seal_weatherproofing: 360-Degree Double-Lip Silicone Visor Gasket creates a 100% watertight seal preventing rain drops from leaking down inside the visor.

introduction: Positioned in AGV's Full Face lineup, the K5 S Camo TC-2 brings Italian engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The AGV K5 S Camo TC-2 represents Italian head protection design, incorporates aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Fiberglass shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel cool air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around 82.5 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a Fiberglass Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the K5 S Camo TC-2 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.

fitment_notes: Optimized for Intermediate Oval head shapes with temple pressure-relief grooves for eyewear. 3D contoured cheek pads experience a 15-20 riding hour break-in period, relaxing by ~20% for facial fitment.
